lines.t: I was running through the noise
Chasing meaning in the dust
Grasping things that slipped away
Every time I placed my trust
I called freedom something loud
I called movement being alive
But I never knew what rest was
Till you called me out of time
You didn't wait for me to find you
You spoke my name and drew me near
In the middle of my wandering
Your voice is all I hear
I am yours, I am gathered, I am home at last with you
Not because I held on tightly, but because you never let me lose
I am yours, I am kept, I can finally rest in truth
I belong not by my strength, but by the promise you made true
I was small among the many
Never strong, never enough
But you called me to your field
Not for numbers, just for love
You weren't searching for my power
You were asking for my yes
You make gold from lowly soil
You make beauty from my mess
You remain the same forever
Forever, I don't shift your hand or care My place is not up for debate
I am safe because you're there
I am yours, I am gathered I am home at last with you
Not because I held on tightly, but because you never let me lose
I am yours, I am kept, I can finally rest in truth
I belong not by my strength, but by the promise you made true
From everlasting you are I am, to everlasting still the same
You knew me long before I knew the sound of your great name
I don't have to prove my place, I don't have to earn my stay
I am held inside the one who was and is and is to reign
I am yours, I am gathered, I am home and I am known
Every fear of being scattered dies inside the truth I'm owned
I am yours, I am kept, this is peace I never knew
Not that I found my way to you
But that you always brought me through
I belong
I am yours
I am home
Thank you.
